newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: STRUGGLING RAINBOW CHICKEN APPOINTS NEW MD.
newsitem.headline: STRUGGLING RAINBOW CHICKEN APPOINTS NEW MD.

text.p: Rainbow Chicken Ltd said on Tuesday it had appointed Jorge Antonio Del Corral Ibarrondo as its new managing director, effective from mid-November.
Del Corral was formerly chief executive of Mexico's Bachoco SA, one of the largest producers of broilers, eggs and pork in Latin America.
Rainbow, hit by rising feed costs and fierce compeition, recorded an attributable loss of 159.8 million rand in the year to end-March on sales of 1.88 billion rand.
Two months ago it warned of further heavy losses in the half-year to September, estimated at around 165 million rand, and announced a recapitalisation rights offer.
The stock hit a year low of 63 in August but has since recovered somewhat, closing at 82 cents on Monday. It stood at a year high of 245 cents in January.
